sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Grandaro is a earth-element weapon used by Monoco. It scales with Vitality (A), Defense (B).

sections.title: Is the Grandaro Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (A), Defense (B). A dedicated earth pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
